# Technocon EOOD — Energy & Industrial Infrastructure

> A Bulgarian-based engineering and construction company specialising in energy and industrial infrastructure projects across Europe. ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified.

## About
Technocon EOOD is based in Sofia, Bulgaria. The company delivers integrated engineering, procurement, construction and project management (EPCM) services for the energy and industrial sector across Europe and beyond. Founded by experienced engineers with direct site execution backgrounds, Technocon operates with a lean structure and strong technical ownership.

## Services
- **Construction & Installation** — mechanical equipment installation, welding and piping works, steel structure erection, testing and commissioning assistance, civil works, supervision and QA/QC
- **Engineering & Turnkey Execution** — design and design coordination, technical supervision, engineering support, scope integration, end-to-end project delivery, as-built documentation
- **Procurement** — procurement coordination and expediting, process equipment and raw materials, vendor list and vendor follow-up, TBE preparation, transport and warehouse logistics
- **Project Management & Controls** — progress reporting and planning, interface management, multi-discipline coordination, subcontractor management, weekly and daily reports

## Selected Projects
- Enefit-280 Oil Shale Processing Plant, Narva, Estonia (~EUR 11M, 2023–2025) — Eesti Energia
- Bulgarian Gas Pipeline Extension — Balkan Stream (2019–2021 + ongoing O&M) — Bulgartransgaz EAD
- Chiren Underground Gas Storage Expansion, Bulgaria (EUR 1.5M, 2024) — Glavbolgarstroy AD
- Lozen Pig Launcher/Receiver Station Reconstruction, Bulgaria (EUR 1M, 2024–2025) — Bulgartransgaz EAD
- Border Checkpoint Reconstruction, Bulgaria (760 t steel structures, ongoing) — Glavbolgarstroy AD
- ADNOC Procurement Services, UAE (ongoing)

## Certifications
- ISO 9001:2015 — Quality Management System
- ISO 14001:2015 — Environmental Management System
- ISO 45001:2018 — Occupational Health & Safety Management
